brief:
Israeli forces shot a Palestinian citizen with live ammunition and arrested a physician after raiding her home in Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation took place in the West Bank city, though additional details about the circumstances of the shooting and the reasons for the doctor's detention were not immediately available.

The incident adds to a series of military operations conducted in the Ramallah area. The condition of the injured Palestinian and the identity of the arrested doctor remain unclear at this time. The raid underscores continuing security operations by Israeli forces in Palestinian population centers across the West Bank.
title: Israeli forces shoot Palestinian, arrest doctor in Ramallah raid
